messages:
maria: Heads-up — SOC wants a time-limited export of auth/audit logs for incident-420. Window: 2026-03-18T00:00Z -> 2026-03-18T06:00Z. Request: 72h TTL on the blob, KMS-wrapped key with JIT unwrap, and download limited to soc-triage group.

alek: clarification: who authorizes the unwrap? how do we make unwraps auditable? and should we hash usernames or redact?

maria: SOC lead will approve via ticket; unwrap must be tied to ticket ID and logged. Prefer hashing user ids with per-export salt, keep IPs for correlation. Full redaction only if legal requires.

tariq: propose ephemeral-kms-proxy flow: exporter writes encrypted blob, proxy issues a short-lived decrypt grant (DateLessThan condition), and the proxy logs grant issuance to the security-audit index. That avoids giving long-lived key access.

sam: implement details: exporter will put object in s3://redwood-temp-exports/incident-420/ and tag object with metadata expiry and intent. Post-export lambda applies lifecycle rule to delete after TTL + buffer. OK to automate deletion?

alek: add allowlist: only IPs in SOC office or VPN should be allowed to download. Downloads must use signed URLs that validate group membership against IDP at request time.

maria: agreed. also need a ticket template that requires justification and list of analysts. attach ticket id to export metadata.

oncall-bot: Deploy checklist:
  1) Create exporter job PR referencing ticket ID
  2) Add KMS policy entry for ephemeral decrypt grants
  3) Add S3 lifecycle rule for 72h TTL + 1h buffer
  4) Create soc-triage IAM group and attach signed-url guard
  5) Ensure all access is logged to security-audit index

maria: I'll file the ticket and post the checklist in #incidents. tagging @alek for the KMS policy.

alek: drafting KMS snippet (pseudo-IAM):

{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01",
  "Condition": {
    "DateLessThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-03-21T12:00:00Z"},
    "StringEquals": {"kms:CallerUserGroup": "soc-triage"}
  }
}

alek: note: the proxy should populate DateLessThan dynamically based on TTL (72h). also add an auditor role that can view audit entries but cannot perform Decrypt.

tariq: exporter should tag object metadata: expiry=2026-03-21T09:15:00Z and x-export-intent=triage-only. also add periodic delete job that emits deletion events to security-audit index.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4162 (exporter + lifecycle). please review.

alek: infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2091 (kms-proxy policy + auditor role).

maria: add runbook for oncall in case export contains PII by mistake — include rollback steps and a contact list.

oncall-bot: Runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/export-triage — please flesh out before merging.

maria: final checklist before go-live: ensure ticket ID is required on PR, signed-url checks IDP group membership at time of request, and all decrypt attempts are emitted to sec-audit. Also forbid ingestion of exported objects into external SIEM unless legal signs off.

alek: I'll add KMS usage telemetry and alert on unusual decrypt patterns (e.g., >3 decrypts for one export).

tariq: acked. I'll wire the deletion verifier and add a nightly verification log to sec-audit.

sam: acked :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone. closing the loop: I'll update the incident ticket with PR links and attach the ticket template. Keep downloads and unwraps strictly auditable.
